plugins.name: sdlc-lite
plugins.description: Interview-driven, test-first, human-in-the-loop workflow that turns a one-line feature request into a reviewed, tested, committed Python change — a conductor plus isolated, model/effort-pinned subagent gates with a guard hook enforcing isolation. Release channel: pinned to a git tag; the product repo's `release.sh` moves the pin. See ADR-13 in Sdaas/sdlc-lite.
